items.docs: Returns all Sources assigned to a Reservation group. Each reservation group can have multiple sources. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).

Returns all Sources assigned to Reservations. Each reservation can have multiple sources. Note this operation uses [Pagination](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/pagination/) and supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property/).
